description:
What a plan would change, resolved against the live document.

The preview never mutates. A plan that cannot be applied as written
produces a blocked preview with the reason, never a partial apply.

approval_id.description: Approval the user has to grant for this plan.

blocked.description: Whether the plan cannot be applied as written.

changed.description: Node ids whose properties would change.

created.description: Node ids that would be created.

created_count.description:
Number of nodes the plan would create.

A node that does not exist yet has no id, so the preview reports the
count here and the applied result reports the real ids.

moved.description: Node ids that would be reparented or repositioned.

operations_count.description: Number of operations in the plan.

plan_hash.description: Hash of the canonical plan. The approval is bound to this hash.

removed.description: Node ids that would be removed.

warnings.description: Reasons a part of the plan could not be resolved.

title: WritePreview
